name: ADI Global Distribution

verdict: PASS 3/10 — the flow setup is real and the asset is worse than the flow is good
PRIMARY_SOURCE: final information statement, Ex-99.1 to the effective 10-12B/A filed 2026-07-01 (acc 0001213900-26-074253). Every number below is from that document, not from a screen.

prior_art_VERIFIED_AND_EXCEEDED.July one-shot claim: '$1B debt + $900M dividend up + 6.6% vs 20% margin split'
prior_art_VERIFIED_AND_EXCEEDED.verified: ALL THREE CONFIRMED. ~$1,000M of new debt (term facility + notes); a one-time $900M cash dividend to Resideo PLUS a separate ~$67M cash payment; FY25 adj EBITDA margin 6.6% exactly.
prior_art_VERIFIED_AND_EXCEEDED.what_the_one-shot_MISSED: a $150M Series A Cumulative Convertible PARTICIPATING preferred, issued to Resideo and exchanged to the Resideo preferred holders. Conversion price $16.152 — ALREADY IN THE MONEY at $22.06 — worth ~9.29M shares, 12.3% dilution. Dividend steps to 10.00% on a Triggering Event. This is a senior claim the flow thesis never priced.

capital_structure.distribution_ratio: 1 ADI for every 2 REZI, record date 2026-07-20
capital_structure.covenant: consolidated total net leverage <=4.75x at the first quarter post-spin, stepping to 4.50 / 4.25 / 4.00 / 3.50 by the ninth quarter — the step-downs are the risk, not the opening level

the_numbers_that_decide_it.FY25_pro_forma: revenue $4,784M | gross profit $1,065M (22.3%) | income from operations $152M (3.2%) | interest $71M | pre-tax $86M | NET INCOME $56M | less $11M preferred dividends = ~$45M to common
the_numbers_that_decide_it.valuation_on_that: EV/EBITDA 8.4x on $318M FY25 adj EBITDA; P/E ~33x fully diluted. NOT a distressed price — a full one.
the_numbers_that_decide_it.Q1_2026_pro_forma_THE_KILLER: revenue $1,206M | income from operations $13M (1.1% margin) | interest expense $18M | PRE-TAX LOSS $(4)M | net loss to common $(6)M | EPS $(0.08). Pro forma, WITH the spin debt, the company loses money at the pre-tax line in its most recent quarter.
the_numbers_that_decide_it.the_trend: Q1 adj EBITDA $65M -> $56M (-13.8%) and margin 5.8% -> 4.6% (-120bps) WHILE REVENUE GREW +7.6%. This is margin compression on rising volume — the worst shape for a levered distributor, because the fixed charge is fixed and the gross margin is not.

FLOW_THESIS_underwritten_separately.the_setup_is_REAL: our spin doctrine holds that the US index leg INVERTS for S&P 500 parents (S&P re-places qualifying spincos same-cycle -> forced BUYING, which killed SOLS/Q/FDXF). The genuine forced-SELL buckets are (a) SP500 parent -> spinco downgraded, or (b) NO index placement. REZI is an S&P 600 parent, so a spinco is very unlikely to earn placement -> bucket (b), the strongest class in the cohort.
why_it_still_does_not_clear: SIGN UNCONFIRMED: S&P's treatment of ADIG is not yet published. The entire flow case rests on an assumption, and if S&P places it the sign inverts and the thesis dies same-day.
SIZE UNQUANTIFIED: I could not compute index-fund holdings of REZI x the 1-for-2 ratio into ADV multiples this session. 'Forced selling' without that number is a story, not a setup.
THE FLOW IS ALREADY 1 DAY OLD and our own cohort work puts the useful window at 0-30 days with a dump-then-base shape. We would be entering mid-window on an unmeasured supply.

MOST DECISIVE: a flow trade needs a bounded holding period AND an asset you would not mind holding if the bounce fails. Pro-forma-unprofitable, 3.1x levered (incl. preferred), with an in-the-money participating preferred ahead of you, is not that asset. The flow could be perfect and the residual still permanent.

four_idea_frame.market_believes: a $4.8B-revenue security-and-AV distributor spun with $1B of debt is worth ~8.4x EBITDA
four_idea_frame.we_believe: the market is approximately right, and the residual risk is asymmetric against us — margins are compressing on growing revenue while the fixed charge just tripled
four_idea_frame.edge: NONE. The only candidate edge was the flow, and it is unconfirmed in sign, unmeasured in size, and attached to an asset we would not want to hold through a failed bounce.
four_idea_frame.why_priced_in: spins have NO research quiet period (our own MBGL doctrine correction) — the sell-side covered this from day one, and the information statement has been public since May 11.

what_would_change_it: a genuine capitulation print — the flow doing its work to a price where EV/EBITDA is ~5-6x, i.e. roughly $12-14, which is also near the preferred's $16.152 conversion
two consecutive quarters of adj EBITDA margin stabilising at or above 5.5%
S&P confirming NO index placement AND a measured forced-supply number in ADV multiples
adjudication_spec: grade 2026-11-15: did ADIG trade below $16.15 (the preferred conversion, our capitulation marker) inside the 0-90 day window? If YES the PASS was too early and the flow was worth renting; if NO the PASS was correct and the forced-selling premise was weaker than the doctrine implies. Either way it grades the spinoff generator's core assumption. ALSO: re-derive the multiples from the first five regular-way sessions before the November grade — the current ones are when-issued artifacts.
generator_feedback: spinoff_orphans should carry (1) a CAP-STRUCTURE field — this record's decisive facts (the $150M in-the-money participating preferred, the $900M dividend, the $1B debt) are all in the information statement the screen already parses, and none of them reach the score; (2) a PRO-FORMA PROFITABILITY flag — 'pro forma pre-tax loss' is a one-line kill that would have demoted ADIG before any court sat.
